query:
SELECT m.id, m.ifoodSku, m.ifoodProductName, m.productId, p.name as productName
FROM ifoodProductMappings m
LEFT JOIN products p ON m.productId = p.id
WHERE (LOWER(m.ifoodProductName) LIKE '%coca cola%' OR LOWER(m.ifoodSku) LIKE '%coca cola%' OR LOWER(p.name) LIKE '%coca cola%')
LIMIT 20;
